meta.title: National labour context — the informal-borrower base (measured)
meta.label: MEASURED — ILOSTAT mirror of Thailand's official NSO LFS submissions (informality, other sectors), OVERLAID with NSO's own quarterly LFS cross-tabs for self-employment + the agriculture sector (source-data/nso_lfs_status.json) AND for the national unemployment rate (source-data/staging/nso_lfs.json, labour-force-weighted over 77 provinces) where those files are present (see nso_source notes on those entries). NATIONAL level only (the geoblock verdict: no cloud path to per-province LFS; vendored SES 2566 remains the per-province source).
meta.nso_override: OVERRODE self_employment and the Agriculture sector row with NSO LFS quarterly 2026-Q1 (source-data/nso_lfs_status.json, pipeline/pull_nso_lfs_status.py) — fresher than the ILOSTAT annual mirror both were carrying.
meta.nso_unemployment_override: OVERRODE unemployment.total_rate_pct with the NSO LFS 2026-Q1 national aggregate (0.94%, labour-force-weighted over 77 provinces, NSO definition) — fresher than and consistent with the district-unemployment lens; was the ILOSTAT annual mirror (0.6% 2025).
meta.why: Informal workers lack payslips — that is the title-loan borrower base. Informality + sector employment set the demand backdrop for every segment score on this platform.

informality.note: share of employment that is INFORMAL (no payslip/social cover) — the core title-loan demographic

self_employment.note: self-employed = own-account + contributing-family + employers — no payslip-issuing employer, the exact vehicle-title borrower profile. NSO LFS quarterly (national, summed over 7 regions x 2 sexes) — supersedes the ILOSTAT annual mirror of this same indicator.

unemployment.note: headline unemployment is structurally low in Thailand because informal work absorbs slack — read WITH the informality rate, not instead of it
unemployment.nso_source: total_rate_pct is the labour-force-weighted NATIONAL aggregate of NSO LFS 2026-Q1 provincial data (source-data/staging/nso_lfs.json — the SAME measured source as the district-unemployment map lens and platform/data/province_lfs.json), on NSO's own definition (unemployed ÷ labour force; the 325k seasonal-waiting workers are a separate category, not counted as unemployed). It SUPERSEDES the ILOSTAT annual mirror this entry carried (0.6% 2025). youth_15_24_rate_pct remains the ILOSTAT annual figure — the provincial LFS cut carries employed-by-age but no unemployed-by-age, so no youth rate is derivable.
